Reaction of trans 2-phenyl-1-bromocyclopentane on reaction with alcoholic KOH produces
solution: Dehydrohalogenation gives the conjugated, more substituted alkene: 1-phenylcyclopentene.
notes: Strict anti-E2 from the trans isomer gives 3-phenylcyclopentene; source key A.

stem: Salicylaldehyde is synthesized from phenol, when reacted with
solution: Reimer–Tiemann reaction: phenol + $\text{CHCl}_3$ + NaOH gives salicylaldehyde.

stem:
Which of the following are aromatic?

A. naphthalene drawn with one ring non-conjugated (1,2-dihydronaphthalene-like), B. styrene, C. bicyclic 10π annulene-type structure, D. [14]annulene
solution: Aromatic compounds must be planar with $(4n+2)\pi$ electrons: B (styrene) and D are aromatic; A and C are non-aromatic.
notes: Structures are images in the source (kept as stem figure); textual descriptions are approximate.
